node.statement: By hypothesis, every nonactor support fiber Q satisfies at least one of: (i) p_Q in conv{p_v,p_w,p_f,p_z,p_o}, or (ii) 0 <= y_Q <= 1. This is the raw dichotomy supplied by the lemma's hypothesis, stated as an inclusive disjunction.
